    COUNT(*) AS total_completed,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_deleted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deleted_completed,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_deleted = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_deleted_completed

FROM jobs

  AND LOWER(gpu_model) LIKE '%h200%'
